evidence.title: BuouUI - React & Tailwind CSS Animated UI Components and Templates

name: BuouUI
summary: Tailwind CSS UI library of 100+ animated React components, landing page sections and Next.js templates, built with Framer Motion.
description: Animated React and Tailwind CSS components, page sections and landing page templates you copy into a project, built with TypeScript, Framer Motion and shadcn/ui. The docs cover 100+ animations and components (backgrounds, buttons, cards, forms, calendars) plus sections such as hero, FAQ, pricing, testimonials, CTA, stats, team, header and footer, and 11 landing page designs. Full source code, starter kits (BuouNext, BuouStore, BuouAI) and an MCP server come with paid plans.
contains: 100+ animated components (backgrounds, buttons, cards, forms, calendars)
sections: hero, FAQ, header, footer, contact, features, testimonials, CTA, stats, team, pricing, blog
11 landing page templates, from Brutal Retro and Pixel Retro to GPT, SEO and E-commerce
Next.js starter kits: BuouNext, BuouStore, BuouAI
